title: Allow per-widget config window sizes/positions
line: Widgets can now choose how big their settings window opens, so small widgets like Show Activity Manager get a small window.
explanation: Each widget already remembers its own settings window size on master (libplasma saves DialogWidth/DialogHeight per applet), but the first time a widget's settings open they always used the shell's fixed 45x35 grid-unit size, because the dialog's root item in AppletConfiguration.qml had a hard-coded implicit size and widgets had no way to influence it. So a widget with three options got the same huge window as Kickoff. libplasma's ConfigModel (the model a widget declares in its config.qml) gains preferredWidth and preferredHeight; AppletConfiguration.qml uses them as its implicit size when set, otherwise the old default. The user's saved size still wins, and Show Activity Manager now asks for the minimum 30x21 grid-unit size.

commits.message:
plasmaquick/configmodel: add preferredWidth and preferredHeight

Every widget's settings window opened at the same default size, which
is far too big for widgets with a few options. A widget's config model
can now suggest the size its settings window opens with the first time.

BUG: 488318

desktoppackage: let widgets choose their settings window's default size

The settings window always opened at the same size no matter how much
the widget had to show. It now uses the size the widget's config model
asks for, and the Activity Manager widget uses this for a smaller one.

BUG: 488318

patches.diff:
From 6b77e4fdce21c54df6f347b846d879ff47ebd3e8 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 20:02:33 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] desktoppackage: let widgets choose their settings window's
 default size

The settings window always opened at the same size no matter how much
the widget had to show. It now uses the size the widget's config model
asks for, and the Activity Manager widget uses this for a smaller one.

BUG: 488318
---
 applets/showActivityManager/qml/config.qml                    | 4 ++++
 desktoppackage/contents/configuration/AppletConfiguration.qml | 4 ++--
 2 files changed, 6 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/showActivityManager/qml/config.qml b/applets/showActivityManager/qml/config.qml
index e61db69079..d60e691da0 100644
--- a/applets/showActivityManager/qml/config.qml
+++ b/applets/showActivityManager/qml/config.qml
@@ -6,9 +6,13 @@
 
 import QtQuick
 
+import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 import org.kde.plasma.configuration
 
 ConfigModel {
+    preferredWidth: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 30
+    preferredHeight: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 21
+
     ConfigCategory {
          name: i18nc("@title page", "Appearance")
          icon: "activities"
diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/AppletConfiguration.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/AppletConfiguration.qml
index e452c7917e..e481aedf4d 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/AppletConfiguration.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/AppletConfiguration.qml
@@ -20,8 +20,8 @@ import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
 Rectangle {
     id: root
 
-    implicitWidth: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 45
-    implicitHeight: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 35
+    implicitWidth: configDialog.configModel?.preferredWidth || Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 45
+    implicitHeight: configDialog.configModel?.preferredHeight || Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 35
 
     Layout.minimumWidth: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 30
     Layout.minimumHeight: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 21
--
